newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO states formally adopt Russia accord.
newsitem.headline: NATO states formally adopt Russia accord.

text.p: NATO's 16 member states formally approved on Friday the historic accord with Russia, negotiated by Secretary General Javier Solana and Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov.
"The North Atlantic Council has given its approval to the Founding Act...between NATO and the the Russian Federation," an official communique said.
The accord was presented to NATO's ambassadors when Solana returned from Moscow on Wednesday, but national capitals were given 48 hours to object.
The communique confirmed the "Founding Act on Mutual Relations, Cooperation and Security between NATO and the Russia Federation" would be signed in Paris on May 27.
Russia has yet to adopt formally the accord which President Boris Yeltsin says answers Moscow's concerns over the alliance's plan to expand eastwards later this year.
